gpsr_manufacturer_id.description: The `economic_operator_id` of the manufacturer, from the [Shop Economic Operators](/documentation/reference#tag/Shop-Economic-Operators) endpoints. Required when `gpsr_manufacturer_type` is `economic_operator`, and rejected when the type is anything else. The operator must belong to this shop and not be deleted. The manufacturer may be located anywhere in the world. If you change `gpsr_manufacturer_type` to `seller` without sending this field, the stored id is cleared for you.

gpsr_manufacturer_type.description: Who the manufacturer of this product is, for GPSR (EU General Product Safety Regulation) purposes. Either `seller` (your shop is the manufacturer) or `economic_operator` (a manufacturer record from the [Shop Economic Operators](/documentation/reference#tag/Shop-Economic-Operators) endpoints, identified by `gpsr_manufacturer_id`). `seller` is rejected when `who_made` is `someone_else`; use `economic_operator` for items made by a third party. Send `null` to clear. Optional for now; it becomes required for listings from eligible traders that sell into the EU 60 days after these fields were announced. See the [GPSR Economic Operators Tutorial](/documentation/tutorials/gpsr-economic-operators) for eligibility and the full flow.

gpsr_responsible_person_id.description: The `economic_operator_id` of the EU responsible person, from the [Shop Economic Operators](/documentation/reference#tag/Shop-Economic-Operators) endpoints. Required when `gpsr_responsible_person_type` is `economic_operator`, and rejected when the type is anything else. The operator must belong to this shop and not be deleted, and its address must be in the European Union. If you change `gpsr_responsible_person_type` to `seller` without sending this field, the stored id is cleared for you.

gpsr_responsible_person_type.description: Who the EU responsible person for this product is, for GPSR purposes. Either `seller` (your shop; only valid when the shop's legal address, or the address on file, is in the European Union) or `economic_operator` (a record from the [Shop Economic Operators](/documentation/reference#tag/Shop-Economic-Operators) endpoints, identified by `gpsr_responsible_person_id`, which must have an address in the European Union). Send `null` to clear. Optional for now; it becomes required for listings from eligible traders that sell into the EU 60 days after these fields were announced. See the [GPSR Economic Operators Tutorial](/documentation/tutorials/gpsr-economic-operators) for eligibility and the full flow.

gpsr_safety_warnings.description: Optional free-text safety warnings and safety information for the product regarding GPSR purposes, shown to buyers as product safety information on the listing page (for example age restrictions, choking hazards, or care and handling instructions). Creates a new economic operator (a manufacturer or EU responsible person record) for a specific shop, used for GPSR compliance on listings. `operator_name`, `email`, `first_line`, `city`, `zip`, `country_iso`, and `phone` are required and cannot be blank; `trademark_name`, `second_line`, and `phone_country_iso` are optional. `state` is required if the `country_iso` requires a state (for example `US`, `CA`, `AU`, `IN`, `BR`, `MX`, `ES`, `IT`); it is optional for every other country. See the [full list of countries](/documentation/tutorials/gpsr-economic-operators#countries-requiring-a-state). The response contains the `economic_operator_id` to pass as `gpsr_manufacturer_id` or `gpsr_responsible_person_id` when creating or updating a [listing](/documentation/reference#tag/ShopListing). A manufacturer can be located anywhere, but an operator used as an EU responsible person must have an address in the European Union; this is checked when a listing references the operator. There is no delete endpoint: use [updateShopEconomicOperator](/documentation/reference#operation/updateShopEconomicOperator) to correct a record. See the [GPSR Economic Operators Tutorial](/documentation/tutorials/gpsr-economic-operators) for the full guide, including eligibility and the enforcement timeline.

phone.description: The contact phone number of the economic operator. Required, cannot be blank. May contain digits, spaces, and the characters ( ) . - + #. Phone number must be valid.

item_weight.description: The numeric weight of the product measured in units set in 'item_weight_unit'. Default value is null. If set, the value must be greater than 0.

should_auto_renew.description: When true, renews a listing for four months upon expiration.

tags.description: A comma-separated list of tag strings for the listing. When creating or updating a listing, valid tag strings contain only letters, numbers, whitespace characters, -, ', ™, ©, and ®. (regex: /[^\p{L}\p{Nd}\p{Zs}\-'™©®]/u) Default value is null.

This endpoint is ready for production use.

Submits tracking information for a Shop Receipt, which creates a Shop Receipt Shipment entry for the given receipt_id. Each time you successfully submit tracking info, Etsy sends a notification email to the buyer User. When send_bcc is true, Etsy sends shipping notifications to the seller as well. When tracking_code and carrier_name aren't sent, the receipt is marked as shipped only. If the carrier is not supported, you may use `other` as the carrier name so you can provide the tracking code. **NOTES** When shipping within the United States AND the order is over $10 _or_ when shipping to India, tracking code and carrier name ARE required. **ACCESS RESTRICTION** In regions where Etsy's Preferred Partner Program is enforced, this endpoint is only available to applications that are approved fulfillment partners. Requests from other applications return `403 Forbidden`, even when the API key is valid, the OAuth token has the `transactions_w` scope and other receipt endpoints respond successfully. A request is authorized if the application is a commercial-access application categorized as Fulfillment or Print On Demand, if it is a personal-use application owned by the authenticated seller, or if the seller authorized the application before the Preferred Partner Program launched in their region. If your application doesn't meet these criteria, contact Etsy API support to ask about partner eligibility. Access to ShopReceipt's first_line, second_line, city, state, zip, country_iso and formatted_address is contingent in some regions to a preferred partnership status with Etsy

tags.description: Economic operators are used to identify the manufacturer and EU responsible person records that the EU General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR) asks sellers to attach to the products they sell to EU buyers. Create them with these endpoints, then reference them from [listings](/documentation/reference#tag/ShopListing) through the `gpsr_*` fields on [createDraftListing](/documentation/reference#operation/createDraftListing) and [updateListing](/documentation/reference#operation/updateListing). See the [GPSR Economic Operators Tutorial](/documentation/tutorials/gpsr-economic-operators) for eligibility, the enforcement timeline, validation rules, and examples.
